name: cfcmt-bus-native-fixed-action-replay-v1
selection: Zero-based chronological free-control ordinal400,1200,2000,2800 along each seed-specific adapted native prefix; free means native projected execution interval lower<upper. Keep all four candidates even when identical. No Q, action-gap, cost, or outcome selection.
baseline: Adapted actor alone drives entire24000s. Match prior all-event diagnosis ledger, population, service, and cost exactly.
intervention: Replay adapted prefix from reset. At one selected event execute the nominated projected action once; remaining same-time slots are recomputed with new actual prior and adapted actor; all subsequent decisions adapted.
same_prefix_checks: Every prefix event batch identity/time, every prior executed control action; equality at selected raw/canonical state, same-time prior, causal arrival tracker, passenger ledger, and all candidate actions.
reuse: Exactly identical projected execution actions within the same selected event share one measured outcome; equality to adapted action shares the baseline. Record reused_from and identical_execution. Reused entries are not independent simulations.
critic_source: Previously recorded three-stage twin-head/min-Q scores on exactly matched native selected states, server-side events.jsonl. Read only; no refit, recomputation, or role in event selection.
primary_cost: (2*accrued_wait_passenger_seconds+accrued_in_vehicle_passenger_seconds)/all_departed_passengers at24000s; report total/component differences and completion.
ranking_comparison: Higher learned min-Q prefers a candidate; lower measured full-horizon cost prefers a candidate. Actual cost ties and identical actions are retained separately; Q is not equated numerically to undiscounted cost.
code_boundary: CFCMT-owned frozen snapshot only; no mutable Thesis access. Remote code/smallJSON/log only, no H5/CSV/checkpoint downloads.
limits: Three training seeds share one previously-used diagnostic demand/SUMO case; twelve event cases are correlated mechanism diagnostics, not twelve independent performance trials.
Single-action effects are conditional on adapted continuation and the fixed candidate set, not effects of continuously deploying a new extraction rule.

Learned critics use scaled undiscounted IQL/H2O+ continuation values, not calibrated cost labels under adapted deterministic continuation. Sign/order agreement with full-horizon adapted-continuation cost is descriptive, not a proof of global calibration.
Fixed ordinals are kept when actors agree; this campaign does not represent only disagreement states or the earlier maximum-divergence event.
